findings.label: Sign application package
findings.text: The zoning application offers wall, freestanding and temporary sign choices. It requests existing/proposed structures, site-plan dimensions, public streets and building/street frontage dimensions for signage. Confirm current submission method and sign-specific supporting drawings.

findings.label: Zoning trigger and face changes
findings.text: The retained text describes zoning certificates for erection, enlargement, alteration including face changes, relocation and reconstruction, subject to exemptions and nonconforming provisions. Current amendments and project applicability remain unreviewed.

findings.label: Cross-reference discrepancy
findings.text: Section 31.1.1 refers to compliance with Article 13 inside Article 31 sign regulations. Preserve this printed cross-reference without silently correcting it; request publisher/staff interpretation.

findings.label: Maintenance and electrical components
findings.text: Routine maintenance language includes lamps, ballast and electrical components as a zoning-certificate exemption. It does not establish an electrical-permit or inspection exemption.

findings.label: Illumination, height and setbacks
findings.text: The page contains shielding, billboard illumination, district-specific height and setback provisions. These numeric provisions remain document candidates rather than approved job constraints. No current electrical code edition or office is established.

findings.label: Sign-area measurement
findings.text: The retained page describes visible display area, multi-face accounting and building sign measurement. Original diagrams on the following pages require visual/table review before a calculation is approved.

findings.label: Prohibitions and conditional exemptions
findings.text: The text lists prohibited sign types and conditional exemptions across districts. Review the complete exceptions and district context; no blanket exemption or approval is created.

findings.label: Retail/industrial portable and freestanding signs
findings.text: The retained page discusses illuminated portable-sign electrical-code compliance and retail/industrial frontage, monument, landscaping and variable-message conditions. It does not identify an electrical permit issuer or inspection provider.

findings.label: Billboard and state-permit review
findings.text: The billboard provisions include size, spacing, maintenance exemptions and possible state transportation permitting. Local zoning review and state-permit review remain distinct pending determinations.

document_version: Cover reports revisions through 2021; 2026 upload path is not currentness proof.
